faqs.question: What are the eligibility requirements for the PMP exam?
faqs.answer: Candidates with a 4-year degree need 36 months of project leadership experience and 35 hours of project management education. High school graduates need 60 months of experience.

faqs.question: What is the structure of the official 2026 PMP exam?
faqs.answer: The PMP exam consists of 180 questions (175 scored, 5 pretest) administered over 240 minutes, covering People (33%), Process (41%), and Business Environment (26%).

faqs.question: How much of the PMP exam covers agile and hybrid project management?
faqs.answer: Approximately 60% of the PMP exam evaluates agile or hybrid project environments alongside traditional predictive waterfall delivery frameworks.

faqs.question: How does TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS assist PMP candidates?
faqs.answer: We offer 1-on-1 domain coaching, scenario practice question reviews, EVM math formula sheets, and custom 4 to 12-week study schedules tailored to your test date.

faqs.question: Is the 35 hours of project management education required before applying?
faqs.answer: Yes. PMI requires completing 35 contact hours of formal project management education prior to submitting your official PMP exam application.

faqs.question: How many mock exams should I take before my PMP test date?
faqs.answer: We recommend taking 3 to 5 full-length, 180-question timed practice exams under simulated test conditions during the final month of revision.
